_doc: Textured floors/ceilings (Modernization): dominant wall code of an
area -> [ceiling texture, floor texture]. v2 after Eric's in-game
review: WALL042 retired (so featureless it reads as untextured from
ceiling distance), and NO pair may use the dominant wall's own
light/dark siblings (WALL015 under c8 and WALL057 under c29 felt
like wall extensions) - gen_flats.py enforces that rule loudly.
WALL033 remains rejected (German-text brick). Doors inherit a
neighboring area's pair so no grey pokes through under them.
